verdict.rationale: Pulumi's pricing page explicitly states 'Self-hosting available' and docs describe a DIY state backend (self-managed S3/Azure Blob/GCS) for state storage, suggesting self-hosting of the core service is possible. However, a hands-on community report explicitly states Pulumi 'only works by calling in to the mothership... you cannot build an airgapped infrastructure with it,' directly contradicting full self-hosting capability. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a concrete self-hosted Pulumi Cloud/service deployment guide, and independent corroboration that a fully air-gapped self-hosted setup works in practice.
